blocks.text: «The number “**ОДИН**” acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case.

**ОДИН** (**ОДНА**, **ОДНО**) declines like **ЭТОТ** (**ЭТА**, **ЭТО**).» «Note that with masculine inanimate nouns the Accusative of “**ОДИН**” is the same as the Nominative. With animate nouns it is the same as the Genitive… The feminine Accusative is always “**ОДНУ**”.»
DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 70, p. 24. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.
